--- title: "06b — Trophic signatures in protist lineages" subtitle: "Frenemies euk metaT — curated grain 4; reads 05b output tables only" author: "Hu Lab" date: last-modified format: html: toc: true toc-depth: 2 code-fold: show df-print: paged --- >SKH: assistant-added (2026-10-22). Reads only output tables and gene lists, so it renders in seconds and does not need `load_long_annot()`. # Questions * **A. Experimental phagotrophy genes.** Which KOs whose loss impairs phagotrophy *in a protist* (knockout, knockdown or silencing; `data/gene-lists/protist_phagotrophy_experimental.csv`) are detected in this dataset, among which lineages, and are they in the vent-associated universe that 07 ranks? * **B. Lineage contrasts.** Do lineages with a documented symbiotic or parasitic lifestyle express a different share of each gene set than their free-living relatives? **Gene sets** come from `data/gene-lists/trophic_gene_sets.csv` (`scripts/00b_build_trophic_gene_sets.R`): KEGG level-C pathways in Transport and catabolism, Signal transduction, Cell growth and death and Cell motility (prokaryote-only maps dropped); the Burns et al. 2018 phagocytosis / photosynthesis / prototrophy families; and the protist experimental set. The curated heterotrophy subcategories (`het_gene_reference.csv`) are added so they can be read against the same contrasts. **Rules.** Same carrier rule as 05b/06: a lineage × KO pair is *detected* when it clears the shared detection rule in ≥ `pair_min_units` (2) units of either habitat (`05b_carrier_pairs.csv.gz`). Presence/absence for detection; summed scaledTPM only as the weight in the depth-matched rarefaction below. # Set up ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} source(if (file.exists("_setup.R")) "_setup.R" else "scripts/_setup.R") ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} PAIR_MIN_UNITS <- params$pair_min_units # 2, as in 05b / 06 N_RAREFY <- 999 # rarefaction draws per contrast MIN_SET_IN_POOL <- 3 # a set needs >= 3 member KOs across the two pools PAIRS_TABLE <- "output-tables/05b_carrier_pairs.csv.gz" SPAN_TABLE <- "output-tables/06_ko_span.csv" # vent-associated universe (07 ranks these) SETS_TABLE <- "data/gene-lists/trophic_gene_sets.csv" # from 00b HET_TABLE <- "data/gene-lists/het_gene_reference.csv" # from 00 EXPERIMENTAL <- "data/gene-lists/protist_phagotrophy_experimental.csv" ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} pairs <- read_csv(PAIRS_TABLE, show_col_types = FALSE) |> mutate(phylum = str_squish(str_extract(cur_phylum, "[^;]+$")), lineage = str_squish(str_extract(cur_L4, "[^;]+$")), tpm_total = tpm_vent + tpm_nonvent) |> filter(n_det_vent >= PAIR_MIN_UNITS | n_det_nonvent >= PAIR_MIN_UNITS) ko_span <- read_csv(SPAN_TABLE, show_col_types = FALSE) trophic_sets <- read_csv(SETS_TABLE, show_col_types = FALSE) het_ref <- read_csv(HET_TABLE, show_col_types = FALSE) experimental <- read_csv(EXPERIMENTAL, show_col_types = FALSE) message(glue("{nrow(pairs)} detected lineage x KO pairs | {n_distinct(pairs$cur_L4)} lineages | ", "{n_distinct(pairs$ko_id)} KOs")) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` 10783 detected lineage x KO pairs | 186 lineages | 3642 KOs ``` ::: ::: # A. Experimental phagotrophy genes One row per gene × KO. `n_lineages` counts class-level lineages with a detected pair; `top_lineages` lists up to five, highest summed scaledTPM first. `in_vent_universe` is whether 07 ranks the KO at all; `span_rank` and `top_carrier` come from 06. >SKH: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} ko_names <- trophic_sets |> distinct(ko_id, ko_name) experimental_detection <- experimental |> separate_longer_delim(ko_id, ";") |> mutate(ko_id = na_if(str_squish(ko_id), "")) |> left_join(ko_names, by = "ko_id") |> left_join(pairs |> summarise(n_lineages = n_distinct(cur_L4), top_lineages = paste(head(lineage[order(-tpm_total)], 5), collapse = " | "), .by = ko_id), by = "ko_id") |> left_join(ko_span |> select(ko_id, span_rank, top_carrier), by = "ko_id") |> mutate(n_lineages = replace_na(n_lineages, 0L), in_vent_universe = ko_id %in% ko_span$ko_id) |> select(gene_label, organism, ko_id, ko_name, n_lineages, top_lineages, in_vent_universe, span_rank, top_carrier, evidence, citation) experimental_detection ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} write_csv(experimental_detection, "output-tables/06b_experimental_ko_detection.csv") ``` ::: > For results: how many experimental KOs are detected, how many enter the vent-associated > universe, and which lineages carry them (`06b_experimental_ko_detection.csv`). # B. Lineage contrasts ## Lineage groups Fixed before looking at the data, from the literature; edit `lineage_groups` to change membership. Each contrast compares lineages with a documented lifestyle (`focal`) against free-living relatives in the same phylum (`reference`). Lineages not listed (e.g. "(unres.)" bins, *Mesodinium*) stay out of both sides. * **Ciliates.** Armophorea, Muranotrichea and Parablepharismea form a clade of obligate anaerobes that all host prokaryotic symbionts (Rotterová et al. 2020, *Curr Biol* 30:2037–2050); Plagiopylea are anaerobic ciliates with prokaryotic symbionts (Fenchel et al. 1977, *J Protozool* 24:154–163), including a denitrifying endosymbiont (Graf et al. 2021, *Nature* 591:445–450). * **Syndiniales.** Parasitoids of other protists (John et al. 2019, *Sci Adv* 5:eaav1110; Farhat et al. 2018, *Front Microbiol* 9:2251), against free-living dinoflagellate lineages. Dinophyceae includes mixotrophs and a few parasites, so the reference is not purely free-living. * **Myzozoa.** Apicomplexans, gregarines, squirmids and perkinsids (parasites) against chromerids and colpodellids (free-living photosynthetic or predatory relatives; Woo et al. 2015, *eLife* 4:e06974; Mathur et al. 2019, *Curr Biol* 29:2936–2941; Leander et al. 2003, *J Eukaryot Microbiol* 50:334–340; Hoppenrath and Leander 2009, *J Eukaryot Microbiol* 56:251–256). >SKH: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} ciliate_reference <- c("Colpodea", "Heterotrichea", "Litostomatea", "Nassophorea", "Oligohymenophorea", "Phyllopharyngea", "Prostomatea", "Spirotrichea") myzozoa_parasite <- c("Aconoidasia", "Apicomplexa (unres.)", "Ancora", "Cardiosporidium", "Cephaloidophora", "Digyalum", "Eleutheroschizon", "Filipodium", "Hammondia", "Lankesteria", "Platyproteum", "Polyplicarium", "Rhytidocystis", "Selenidium", "Siedleckia", "Squirmida (unres.)", "Perkinsea (unres.)", "Perkinsida") myzozoa_freeliving <- c("Alphamonadaceae", "Chromeraceae", "Chromerida_X", "Colpodellaceae", "Colpodellida (unres.)", "Colponema", "Colponemidia (unres.)", "Vitrellaceae") lineage_groups <- bind_rows( tibble(contrast = "Ciliates: anaerobic, symbiont-bearing vs. other classes", phylum = "Alveolata-Ciliophora", role = "focal", lineage = c("Armophorea", "Muranotrichea", "Parablepharismea", "Plagiopylea")), tibble(contrast = "Ciliates: anaerobic, symbiont-bearing vs. other classes", phylum = "Alveolata-Ciliophora", role = "reference", lineage = ciliate_reference), # Syndiniales: every lineage of the curated Syndiniales phylum, plus Amoebophryaceae # wherever the curation placed it pairs |> filter(phylum == "Alveolata-Syndiniales") |> distinct(phylum, lineage) |> mutate(contrast = "Syndiniales vs. free-living dinoflagellates", role = "focal"), tibble(contrast = "Syndiniales vs. free-living dinoflagellates", phylum = "Alveolata-Dinophyta", role = "focal", lineage = "Amoebophryaceae"), tibble(contrast = "Syndiniales vs. free-living dinoflagellates", phylum = "Alveolata-Dinophyta", role = "reference", lineage = c("Dinophyceae", "Noctilucales", "Oxyrrhinales")), tibble(contrast = "Myzozoa: parasites vs. free-living relatives", phylum = "Alveolata-Myzozoa", role = "focal", lineage = myzozoa_parasite), tibble(contrast = "Myzozoa: parasites vs. free-living relatives", phylum = "Alveolata-Myzozoa", role = "reference", lineage = myzozoa_freeliving)) stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(lineage_groups[c("contrast", "phylum", "lineage")])) grouped_pairs <- pairs |> inner_join(lineage_groups, by = c("phylum", "lineage"), relationship = "many-to-many") # KO pool per side: union of member lineages, weight = summed scaledTPM pools <- grouped_pairs |> summarise(weight = pmax(sum(tpm_total), 1e-9), # a detected pair always counts n_lineages = n_distinct(cur_L4), .by = c(contrast, role, ko_id)) pool_sizes <- pools |> summarise(n_kos = n_distinct(ko_id), .by = c(contrast, role)) |> left_join(grouped_pairs |> summarise(lineages = paste(sort(unique(lineage)), collapse = ", "), .by = c(contrast, role)), by = c("contrast", "role")) pool_sizes ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: Listed lineages that are absent from `pool_sizes` had no detected pair. ## Gene sets >SKH: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} het_sets <- het_ref |> filter(!is.na(subcategory)) |> distinct(set_name = subcategory, ko_id) |> mutate(set_source = "het_subcategory") contrast_sets <- trophic_sets |> distinct(set_source, set_name, ko_id) |> bind_rows(het_sets) |> distinct(set_source, set_name, ko_id) contrast_sets |> summarise(n_sets = n_distinct(set_name), .by = set_source) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: ## Depth-matched comparison A lineage pool with few detected KOs holds mostly its most highly expressed ones, so a raw "share of the repertoire in set X" mixes biology with sequencing depth. Here both pools are **rarefied to the same number of KOs** (the smaller pool's size), drawing KOs without replacement with probability proportional to their summed scaledTPM, which mimics detection at a lower depth. For each set and draw: `diff = members in focal − members in reference`. Reported per set: median `diff`, its 2.5–97.5% range over `N_RAREFY` draws, and `frac_focal_higher`. **This is a rarefaction summary, not a hypothesis test**: an interval that excludes 0 means the difference holds at matched depth, nothing more, and with pools of tens of KOs it should be read as exploratory. >SKH: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} rarefied_contrast <- function(pool_focal, pool_ref, sets, n_draws = N_RAREFY) { n_draw <- min(nrow(pool_focal), nrow(pool_ref)) set_ids <- sets |> filter(ko_id %in% c(pool_focal$ko_id, pool_ref$ko_id)) |> add_count(set_source, set_name, name = "n_in_pools") |> filter(n_in_pools >= MIN_SET_IN_POOL) if (!nrow(set_ids) || n_draw < 2) return(tibble()) # KO x set incidence, so one draw is a single colSums() set_keys <- set_ids |> distinct(set_source, set_name) |> mutate(key = paste(set_source, set_name, sep = " :: ")) all_kos <- union(pool_focal$ko_id, pool_ref$ko_id) incidence <- matrix(0L, length(all_kos), nrow(set_keys), dimnames = list(all_kos, set_keys$key)) incidence[cbind(set_ids$ko_id, paste(set_ids$set_source, set_ids$set_name, sep = " :: "))] <- 1L draw_counts <- function(pool) { replicate(n_draws, colSums(incidence[sample(pool$ko_id, n_draw, prob = pool$weight), , drop = FALSE])) } diffs <- matrix(draw_counts(pool_focal) - draw_counts(pool_ref), nrow = nrow(set_keys)) # member KO ids on each side, so overlap between KEGG maps is visible # (the same cathepsin or V-ATPase can sit in Lysosome, Phagocytosis and Apoptosis) members_in <- function(pool) { map_chr(set_keys$key, \(k) paste(sort(intersect(pool$ko_id, all_kos[incidence[, k] == 1L])), collapse = " | ")) } set_keys |> mutate(n_rarefied = n_draw, in_focal_pool = colSums(incidence[pool_focal$ko_id, , drop = FALSE]), in_ref_pool = colSums(incidence[pool_ref$ko_id, , drop = FALSE]), focal_member_kos = members_in(pool_focal), ref_member_kos = members_in(pool_ref), diff_median = apply(diffs, 1, median), diff_lo = apply(diffs, 1, quantile, 0.025), diff_hi = apply(diffs, 1, quantile, 0.975), frac_focal_higher = rowMeans(diffs > 0), frac_ref_higher = rowMeans(diffs < 0), interval_excludes_0 = diff_lo > 0 | diff_hi < 0) |> select(-key) } set.seed(params$seed) contrast_results <- pools |> nest(.by = contrast) |> mutate(result = map(data, \(d) rarefied_contrast( pool_focal = d |> filter(role == "focal"), pool_ref = d |> filter(role == "reference"), sets = contrast_sets))) |> select(contrast, result) |> unnest(result) |> arrange(contrast, desc(interval_excludes_0), desc(abs(diff_median))) message(glue("{nrow(contrast_results)} contrast x set rows | ", "{sum(contrast_results$interval_excludes_0)} with a 95% rarefaction interval excluding 0")) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` 146 contrast x set rows | 33 with a 95% rarefaction interval excluding 0 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} contrast_results |> filter(interval_excludes_0) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} write_csv(contrast_results, "output-tables/06b_lineage_contrast_sets.csv") write_csv(pool_sizes, "output-tables/06b_lineage_contrast_pools.csv") ``` ::: > For results: per contrast, the sets whose rarefaction interval excludes 0, with pool sizes > from `06b_lineage_contrast_pools.csv`. Small pools (tens of KOs) limit what any set can show. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} contrast_results |> filter(interval_excludes_0) |> mutate(set_label = fct_reorder(paste0(set_name, " [", set_source, "]"), diff_median)) |> ggplot(aes(x = diff_median, y = set_label)) + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, colour = "grey50") + geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = diff_lo, xmax = diff_hi), height = 0.2) + geom_point(size = 2) + facet_wrap(~contrast, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") + labs(x = "Member KOs, focal − reference (rarefied to equal pool size; median, 95% range)", y = NULL) + theme_bw(base_size = 10) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Warning: `geom_errorbarh()` was deprecated in ggplot2 4.0.0. ℹ Please use the `orientation` argument of `geom_errorbar()` instead. ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` `height` was translated to `width`. ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](06b-trophic-lineages_files/figure-html/fig-rarefied-contrast-1.png){#fig-rarefied-contrast width=864} ::: ::: # QC ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} stopifnot( !anyDuplicated(experimental_detection[c("gene_label", "ko_id")]), all(pool_sizes$n_kos > 0), all(contrast_results$diff_lo <= contrast_results$diff_median), all(contrast_results$diff_median <= contrast_results$diff_hi), all(contrast_results$frac_focal_higher + contrast_results$frac_ref_higher <= 1 + 1e-9) ) ``` ::: # Session Info ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} sessionInfo() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` R version 4.6.0 (2026-04-24) Platform: aarch64-apple-darwin23 Running under: macOS Sequoia 15.8.1 Matrix products: default BLAS: /Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/4.6/Resources/lib/libRblas.0.dylib LAPACK: /Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/4.6/Resources/lib/libRlapack.dylib;
